plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp boxing S&C build for a beginner with only one 45-minute session each week and plenty of sparring to recover around. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body strength lift so later loading can stay simple and accurate. The main program starts in Week 2 and keeps the session focused on power first, then strength, then a small amount of upper-back, trunk, and neck work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish a squat baseline, then build general strength and basic explosive power without creating extra fatigue that interferes with boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts steadily and keep power outputs crisp while managing fatigue around sparring and skill work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper sport-relevant power while keeping enough strength work to hold onto force.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and land quietly. Every rep should be crisp and confident.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if boxes are busy or the athlete is more comfortable jumping in place.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with several small jumps in load, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps. Stop with solid form and log the top set because this will set your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.
